args.text: Draft the Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team here: first report time, when kiosk 1 came back, and when both lanes were confirmed working.

@Gideon, here's the draft for Mateo's procurement team. Sources: #inc-vtg-hartford and SUP-5380.

Hartford gate kiosk incident (VTG), 3 Aug 2026

- First report: SUP-5380 was opened as Sev 1 with a log entry at 08:12, when the kiosk reboot had failed and drivers were queueing. The first message in the incident room was at 10:42, when both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03. The guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07, per Gideon in the incident room (posted 11:08).
- Still open: status-page access for Mateo's login (ticket INC-4821). Scheduling and the Pemberline Dock admin view were working throughout.

Please confirm which first-report time you want to use. The ticket log (08:12) and the incident room (10:42) differ.

@Gideon, correction to my draft: I overstated one line. The thread only shows scheduling working from the dispatch office and Mateo's admin account seeing Pemberline Dock arrivals. It does not say they worked throughout the outage. Please use only those two points.

Draft posted in #strategic-random, in reply to your message.

FINAL: Hartford gate kiosk incident (VTG), 3 Aug 2026. For Mateo's procurement team.

- First report: SUP-5380 was logged Sev 1 with an 08:12 update, when the kiosk reboot had failed and drivers were queueing. The first message in the incident room is at 10:42, when both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03. The guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07, per Gideon in the incident room.
- Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt) was checking the Hartford gateway route, and asked that kiosk 2 stay powered on so reconnect attempts could continue.
- Scheduling worked from the dispatch office, and Mateo's admin account could open Pemberline Dock and see today's arrivals.
- Still open: status-page access for Mateo's login, tracked in INC-4821.

Posted the FINAL summary in #strategic-random, as a reply to your message.

It adds Odile's gateway check and the INC-4821 tracking, and keeps the first-report discrepancy: the ticket shows 08:12 and the incident room starts at 10:42. Someone should pick one before it goes to Mateo's team.
